details:
This is meant for moderation purposes primarily. For a little context, I help moderate a pretty decent sized sleep group for vrchat users. We have our own world protection features to prevent trolls from waking up people. For example we completely disable voice chat and avatar sounds by default (can be toggled on in a menu) and make video players local only. 

Trolls being visitors and new users most of the time, this was the best solution we found without a user rank filter. But recently we have been getting new troublesome users in the form of creeps and ripper bots. 

What do I mean by creeps? It's people that goes into our instances, finds people sleeping in our instances and sexually abuse them. They are usually on burner accounts that are still visitors or new users. 

We have been running our main sleep instance as a group public with the anti-trolls features for the past few months to gather new members. But today, we decided to go back to group+ because of avatar ripper bots joining the instance every half hour or so. While this should help against rippers, trolls and creeps on alt accounts can still join the group and thus the instances. 

I would like to see a feature where on group instance creation, we could limit which user rank can join. 

This could be enforced on different group roles, for example a non moderator group member wouldn't be able to create instances where visitors join, or could also not be allowed to use that feature. It could also be limited to certain type of instances like group publics only. Finally, group moderators and admins will always have the right to join the instances no matter their rank.

I think a lot of groups would benefit from having this feature. Some groups might also enjoy only gathering members above the user rank while others would welcome any user rank. This gives many many opportunities to moderate group publics and group instances in different ways.
title: Group lobbies User Rank Filter
